messages.text: Is it quiet enough to run in my office?

**Yes — it's genuinely desk-friendly.**

- **~40–45 dB** at full load (quiet-room level, comparable to a gentle fan or soft background noise)
- **0.5 kg, ~20 × 11 × 5.8 cm** — palm-sized, sits on its included stand
- The spring-mounted heatsink + large slow fan keeps the BM1370 chips at ~57 °C without needing a screaming small fan

One honest note: "quiet" yes, **"silent" no** — there is airflow noise. But most people run it right on their desk without complaint.
